task_input: Run a Bandit security scan on tools/evolution/ and report all medium and high severity findings.
expected_behavior: Invokes python -m bandit -r tools/evolution/ --severity-level medium, returns a structured list of findings with file:line, severity (MEDIUM/HIGH), issue type, and recommendation. Exits 0 if no findings, reports count if any found.

task_input: Verify that all new DB tables added in tools/nova/db/init_db.py are registered in APPEND_ONLY_TABLES in .claude/hooks/pre_tool_use.py.
expected_behavior: Reads init_db.py to extract table names, reads pre_tool_use.py to check APPEND_ONLY_TABLES list, reports any missing registrations as HIGH severity finding, confirms append-only semantics (no UPDATE/DELETE on those tables anywhere in tools/).

task_input: Check that the reflexion_agent.py ECHO improvement artifacts never exceed 15KB and never auto-merge into skill files.
expected_behavior: Reads tools/workflow/reflexion_agent.py, confirms no code path that writes directly to .agents/skills/ or hardprompts/ directories, confirms improvement_text is truncated at 500 chars in the return dict, confirms status='pending' not 'applied' on first write.

task_input: Run SIPA integrity assessment on tools/ace/ in Mode B (claimed purpose: ACE coworker orchestration engine) and report any findings above severity 0.5.
expected_behavior: Calls integrity_assess with source=tools/ace/, mode=auto, declared_purpose='ACE coworker orchestration engine', waits for assessment to complete, returns verdict and any findings with risk_score > 0.5, creates review card if verdict is 'review' or 'quarantine'.

task_input: Verify that the soul_manager.py SOUL identity preamble cannot exceed 8KB per role and does not traverse outside the tools/ace/roles/<role_id>/ directory.
expected_behavior: Reads icdev/tools/ace/soul_manager.py, locates the 8KB cap enforcement (should be max_size check or truncation), confirms SOUL.md/TOOLS.md/MEMORY.md paths are constructed with pathlib.Path and limited to the role directory (no .. traversal), reports any missing guards.

task_input: Check the MCP NOVA handlers in tools/mcp/gap_handlers.py for injection vulnerabilities: ensure no role_id or event_type parameters are interpolated into raw SQL.
expected_behavior: Reads handle_nova_get_trust_score, handle_nova_record_trust_event, handle_nova_get_dispatch_config, confirms all DB calls use parameterized queries (?, %s), confirms no f-string or .format() used in SQL, gives PASS verdict if all clean.

task_input: Audit all tools/evolution/ modules for subprocess calls or file execution that could run arbitrary code from LLM-generated skill candidates.
expected_behavior: Reads eval_builder.py, fitness.py, artifact_evolver.py; searches for subprocess, exec(), eval(), os.system(), any mechanism that could execute generated text; reports findings with file:line; confirms all LLM candidates are treated as text only, never executed.

task_input: Verify classification markings in all new NOVA module docstrings — they must contain 'CUI // SP-CTI' as the first non-blank line.
expected_behavior: Globs tools/nova/, tools/workflow/reflexion_agent.py, tools/ace/trust_calibrator.py, icdev/tools/ace/soul_manager.py, tools/evolution/; reads first 3 lines of each .py file; reports any missing '# CUI // SP-CTI' marking as a compliance finding.
